answer_2.quote: Experiments show that TOW-augmented models improve up to 23% on reasoning datasets (GSM8K, CommonsenseQA, StrategyQA) and up to 10% on hallucination benchmarks (TruthfulQA, HaluEval).

answer_3.quote: We further employ a smaller model, GPT-4o-mini, to better distinguish between soft consistency and unpredictable words. ... we use GPT-4o-mini to compare the generated content with the actual observed next word.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation revealed two primary failure modes of TOW: 1) Repetitive Intermediary TOW Generation ... 2) Misplaced TOW Generation ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluated TOW sequences for repetitiveness and whether they appeared after the answer.
